about: Rafa's note and the Diário prompt for the Treino app

lines.pt: E aí, sofredor! Quinta-feira, bom dia!
Ontem eu fui pro shopping comprar uma camiseta, tava mó calor.
lines.en: Yesterday I went to the shopping centre to buy a T-shirt, it was really hot.

lines.pt: Ficou pequena, aí o vendedor trouxe uma G pra mim.
lines.en: It was too small, so the assistant brought me a large.

lines.pt: Se leva duas, sai mais barato, então levei as duas e paguei no Pix!
lines.en: If you take two it works out cheaper, so I took both and paid with Pix!

q.pt: E cê, quando compra roupa, paga no crédito ou no débito?
q.en: And you, when you buy clothes, do you pay by credit or debit?

diario.pt: No episódio, o George compra roupa num shopping lotado. E o seu dia hoje? Escreve três frases no passado: "Hoje eu fui… / Hoje eu comi… / Hoje eu falei…"
diario.en: In the episode, George buys clothes in a packed shopping centre. And your day today? Write three sentences in the past tense: "Today I went… / Today I ate… / Today I spoke…"
